title: Grandleon Scene Cast
notes: A scene naming who each of its speakers is. The three cases a client has to tell apart are all here: a speaker the cast names and whose character draws as the game does, a speaker the cast names and whose character names a style and a figure of its own, and a speaker the cast does not name at all — which must be drawn exactly as a speaker was drawn before a scene could name one. The second scene casts nobody, which is every scene ever authored before this field.

unitTypes.name: Demo Soldier
unitTypes.notes: Names no style and no figure, so the cast resolves to the game's own drawing.

unitTypes.name: Wild Mage
unitTypes.notes: Names both, so a portrait that read only the archetype would draw the wrong hand and the wrong build.

lines.speaker: Halvard
lines.text: The gate is barred from the inside.

lines.speaker: Briar
lines.text: Then we will ask it to stop being a gate.

lines.speaker: Halvard
lines.text: That is not how gates work.

lines.speaker: A Voice Behind the Gate
lines.text: It is how this one works.

lines.speaker: Halvard
lines.text: A scene that casts nobody, and names no backdrop either.
